_comment: Issue #97 diagnostic: 4 TYP corners with internal-node swing probes (CK from cml2cmos, CKL buffered clock, TC, psp/psn mean). Same body/start-up as request-stage2.json.

measurements.name: ipavg
measurements.spice: .meas tran ipavg avg i(vddp) from=40n to=120n

measurements.name: idavg

measurements.name: tfb
